blocks.text: Banda pushes the argument further, saying that if he turns from his declared path he will make himself, his word, and even scriptural truth appear false.
The page then turns toward a new sub-section around Kali’s food, presenting destruction as still unsatisfied and widening the theological register of the violence.
It stands at the hinge between moral justification and a more ominous, sacrificial imagination of battle.
